preconditions.description: n must be a positive integer.

postconditions.description: The function returns a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(i * i <= n for i in range(1, int(n**0.5) + 1))
postconditions.description: The function considers all perfect squares less than or equal to n.

postconditions.expression: any(sum(squares) == n for squares in combinations_with_replacement(perfect_squares, return_value))
postconditions.description: There exists a combination of perfect squares that sum to n.
